evidence: Inspected full lifted body: initializes a large stack record, routes a selector through a global-table lookup, conditionally resolves player-attribute context, checks supported attribute values, and invokes four opaque update helpers. Without indexed callers or resolved helper meanings, the overall operation is not specific enough to name. Source: decompiled/main/main_0083.c:51872-51971.

The body initializes output fields, resolves an identifier through context/status helpers, then calls the accepted strided_record_table_lookup (0x700181ad74) on the global record table. On success it stores the returned record pointer at output+0xa0 and copies the record halfword at +0x98 to output+0xd0; failure clears the cached pointer. No indexed callers are available. Source: decompiled/main/main_0088.c:36189-36256; lookup behavior tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:63.

The body resolves a context identifier and reads attribute-context status 0x13. It conditionally stores the resolved halfword into byte field +0x99 when the status/field guards pass, then uses that value to locate an 8-byte-strided subrecord and conditionally stores it at +0x363 before calling a context helper. This names only the visible status-field update; exact record meaning is unresolved and no callers are indexed. Source: decompiled/main/main_0088.c:37185-37259; status accessor tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:77.

Initializes output to -1 and proceeds only when attribute-context status selector 0x13 equals 4. It follows the nested provider path, queries player attribute ID 0x11, requires the returned float to equal 1.0, then writes 1 exactly when the nested record halfword at +0x20 has no bits set in mask 0x0e; otherwise it leaves the default. No indexed callers are available. Source: decompiled/main/main_0124.c:50399-50471; accepted helpers player_attribute_get_float (tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:65) and attribute_context_status_value_get (tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:77).

Initializes output to -1 and proceeds only when attribute-context status selector 0x13 equals 4 and global/nested provider guards pass. It obtains nested-provider floats for IDs 3 and 7, converts each to signed int32, subtracts the second from the first, and writes the delta. No indexed callers are available. Source: decompiled/main/main_0125.c:12491-12557; accepted helpers nested_attribute_provider_get_float (tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:70) and attribute_context_status_value_get (tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:77).
